reply_text:
I found six 2026 claims from Hassabis on pages I opened. Four have not been recorded before. One repeats a recorded claim, and one says the same thing as a recorded claim but on a different occasion. The two strongest new finds are his own words in a printed interview and in a transcript, both from the week of Google I/O in May.

- **Fast Company, May 2026:** He said, "2030 is when I expect it to arrive, either plus or minus a year." This is the same 2030 forecast as the 2026-06-02 file but a different occasion, so I left `already_recorded` empty. In the same article he said bringing the Gemini Spark agent to ordinary users is "probably going to play out over the rest of the year." The piece also says he predicted AI could accelerate chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear threats over the next year to year and a half. I saw that line only in the search snippet because the page I opened was cut off, so I haven't quoted it.
- **Stanford talk, May 2026 (transcript published June 18):** The automated transcript says AGI is "maybe like 20, 30 plus or minus a year". That is almost certainly "2030" garbled, and I quoted it exactly as printed.
- **India AI Impact Summit, February 2026:** Business Today reports him putting AGI "maybe in the next five to eight years." It also reports a "golden era for scientific discovery" within "probably 10 years," and robotics "breakout moments" in the next two to three years. I saw these only in news coverage. For the robotics claim, only "breakout moments" is printed as his own words.
- **Fortune interview, February 11, 2026:** The line about Isomorphic's drugs going towards clinical trials by the end of the year is the claim already recorded in the 2026-01 file. The robotics "next 18 months" line was cut off the page I opened, so I left it out.

Several things are unconfirmed or held back:
- **July 14, 2026 essay on X:** It says AGI is "probably only a few short years away." I couldn't open X, so I haven't quoted it and it isn't in `undated`.
- **October 15 report:** It says AI agent hacks could become major "looking into next year and the next couple years." That page also couldn't be opened, so I haven't quoted it.
- **Stanford "foothills of the singularity" line:** It's about how people will look back in ten years, not about AI doing something by a date, so I left it out.

I used 10 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings. One fixed search was run twice because the first attempt's results weren't displayed. Two openings failed: the X post and the October 15 article (url_not_allowed).
